purpose: Recognize one CSS number representation directly with parse-that and preserve the grammar facts required for later exact numeric conversion.

normative_authority.title: CSS Syntax Module Level 3
sections: 4.3.10 Check if three code points would start a number
4.3.13 Consume a number, steps 1-5 and type/sign portions of step 7

normative_routing.included: Number-start recognition, maximal representation consumption, integer/number type classification, and explicit sign preservation.
normative_routing.excluded: Base-10 mathematical interpretation in consume-a-number steps 6-7 is routed to a separate VALUE-NUMBER-VALUE row; numeric-token percentage/dimension classification is routed to later rows.

input_contract.trivia: No leading or trailing trivia; callers compose accepted trivia productions outside this parser.
input_contract.runtime_domain: string only; non-string handling belongs to a public adapter.

success_observation.classification: type is number when a fractional or exponent part is consumed; otherwise integer. The spelling and sign preserve leading zeros, exponent case/sign, and negative zero.

diagnostics.actual: one source code unit or null

failure_observation.normalization: If no CSS number starts at offset 0, report number_syntax at 0. Otherwise consume the longest valid number representation and report trailing_input at its end when source remains.

serialization: Identity of value.representation. This row performs no canonical numeric rewriting.
complexity: O(source.length), no recursion, no token/CST allocation, no numeric conversion, and no artificial digit or exponent cap.

required_seats.provenance: Historical direct parse-that number terminal at value.js f5723e72, utils.ts SHA-256 bcaa6cb2206a1d57776a71c260b6ed30e8c29ad48ed4f1069def2896a650133c.
required_seats.topology: Historically shaped terminal transpose, corrected against the frozen row.

required_seats.provenance: Pinned CSS Syntax algorithms only; no H/B implementation source.
required_seats.topology: Explicit parse-that production tree using independently derived sign, integer/fraction, and exponent branches.

required_seats.provenance: Clean-room engine-native construction from the frozen contract and published parse-that API only.
required_seats.topology: Prefix-directed dispatch/chain construction; mandatory because H/B independence is not established.

candidate_generation.isolation: Authors share only this exact feature hash, fixture manifest, published @mkbabb/parse-that@1.0.0, and the observation harness. Candidate parser code and design notes are isolated until close.

benchmark.operation: Complete-input parse to the exact success/failure observation above; grammar only, no public adapter and no Number conversion.
benchmark.full_domain_lane: All valid and invalid corpus bytes for H/B/S/D and the eventual accepted candidate.
benchmark.common_domain_lane: Only inputs on which historical/live peers implement the same accepted language and observation; no full-domain credit follows from this lane.
benchmark.strict_win: After semantic equality, the one-sided paired confidence interval for candidate/peer time lies wholly below 1.0.

admission: Two independent boundary challenges and one gestalt adjudication must accept the exact feature and fixture-manifest hashes before any candidate source is authored.
